description: Fetch a paper's full body text as Markdown (methods, results, protocols, inline tables) — use for deep questions the abstract can't answer. Accepts a PMC ID (PMC5339222) or a bioRxiv/medRxiv DOI (10.1101/…). For an arXiv ID (2401.12345) it returns the summary view and a link to the full text on arxiv.org, which Tomesphere does not host.

id.description: arXiv ID, PMC ID, or 10.1101/… DOI.

name: get_full_text
